title: E2 app cannot start (the qa port is held by a process the run did not start): all blocked, no fake pass
ticket: GET /users should include each user's latest order.

steps: start the app on the qa port
cases.expect: 200; each item has latestOrder = the user's newest order

observed.note: the app exits with EADDRINUSE: another process holds the qa port; tbx req refuses it (a listener this run did not start)

cases.expect: 400: the page bounds hold as before

observed.note: no app of this run on the qa port

findings: the qa port is held by another process: free it, then run QA again
